questions.question_text: Which of these best describes the primary goal of the ACT English Test?
options: It tests your ability to write creative essays from scratch.
It measures your skill in editing and revising short texts.
It focuses on memorizing complex grammar rules.
It asks you to rewrite entire historical novels.
questions.explanation: The test measures your ability to make decisions to revise and edit short texts and essays in different genres.

questions.question_text: What is the time limit for the English Test section?
questions.explanation: The English Test is designed to be completed in 35 minutes.

questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of the ACT English Test?
options: To test your ability to read and understand complex literature.
To evaluate your skill in revising and editing short texts and essays.
To measure your knowledge of historical English documents.
To assess your speed in writing creative stories.
questions.explanation: The English Test is specifically designed to measure a student's ability to edit and revise various texts for clarity and correctness.

questions.question_text: How many minutes are allotted for the English Test?
questions.explanation: The ACT website states that the English Test is 35 minutes long.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is evaluated in the ACT English Test?
options: Decision-making for editing texts in different genres
questions.explanation: The English section measures your ability to make decisions to revise and edit short texts and essays in different genres.

questions.question_text: What is the primary focus of the ACT English Test?
options: Evaluating and editing short texts and essays
questions.explanation: The English Test specifically measures a student's ability to edit and revise texts in various genres.

questions.question_text: How much time do students have to complete the English Test?
questions.explanation: The ACT English Test is designed to be completed within a 35-minute timeframe.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is true regarding the English Test?
options: It requires knowledge of various editing genres.
It is exclusively focused on poetry analysis.
questions.explanation: The test measures editing and revision skills across different genres of text.

questions.question_text: How many questions are included in the English Test section?
questions.explanation: The ACT English Test contains 50 questions.

questions.question_text: What type of skills does the ACT English Test evaluate?
questions.explanation: The test evaluates your ability to make revision and editing decisions in text.
